Rashi on Arakhin 7b:10:1.hebrew: אלא א"ר נחמן - לעולם שערה ממש. ודקשיא לך: "איסורי הנאה נינהו?" — ל"ק: דשיער המת לא מיתסר בהנאה, דלא דמי לשיער בהמה שנהרגה; דאשה מיתתה אוסרתה, ושיער לאו בר מיתה הוא, שאין עשוי להשתנות. אבל בהמה, גמר דינה אוסרתה, כדאמר בפסחים בפ' כל שעה (פסחים דף כב:): ממשמע שנאמר: "סקל יסקל השור", איני יודע שהוא נבילה ואסורה באכילה? ומה ת"ל: "לא יאכל את בשרו"? מגיד שאם שחטו לאחר גמר דינו — אסור. ואין לי אלא באכילה, בהנאה מנין? כו'. והילכך, כל דמחובר בה בשעת גמר דין מיתסר בהדה:
Rashi on Arakhin 7b:10:1.english: Rather, Rav Naḥman said - Actually, [the Mishnah is referring to] her actual hair. And [as for] that which was difficult to you: "They are items forbidden from benefit?" — this is not difficult: for the hair of a corpse is not forbidden from benefit, as it is not similar to the hair of an animal that was executed; for [in the case of] a woman, her death makes her forbidden, and hair is not subject to death, as it does not undergo change. But [in the case of] an animal, its verdict makes it forbidden, as [the Gemara] says in Pesachim, in the chapter 'Kol Sha'ah' (Pesachim 22b): "From the implication of that which is stated: 'The ox shall surely be stoned,' do I not know that it is a carcass and [therefore] forbidden to be eaten? And why does the verse state: 'its flesh shall not be eaten'? It tells [us] that if one slaughtered it after its verdict, it is forbidden. And I have [derived] only regarding eating; from where [do I derive it] regarding benefit? etc." And therefore, whatever is attached to it at the time of the verdict becomes forbidden along with it.

Rashi on Arakhin 7b:11:1.hebrew: תני לוי כוותיה דרב - דמוקים לה בדאמרה: "תנו", ובפיאה נכרית:
Rashi on Arakhin 7b:11:1.english: Levi teaches in accordance with Rav - For he establishes it [the Mishnah] as [dealing with a case] where she said, "Give," and regarding a wig.

Rashi on Arakhin 7b:11:2.hebrew: מתה - ולא אמרה: "תנו", אין נותנין כו':
Rashi on Arakhin 7b:11:2.english: [If] she died - And she did not say, "Give," they do not give [it], etc.

Rashi on Arakhin 7b:11:3.hebrew: מת אסור בהנאה - דכתיב: "ותמת שם מרים", וגמר "שם" "שם" מעגלה ערופה, במסכת ע"ז באין מעמידין (ע"ז דף כט:):
Rashi on Arakhin 7b:11:3.english: A corpse is forbidden to derive benefit from - For it is written: "And Miriam died there," and [the Gemara] derives [by a verbal analogy of] "there" [and] "there" from the heifer whose neck is broken, in tractate Avodah Zarah in [the chapter] "Ein Ma'amidin" (Avodah Zarah 29b).

Rashi on Arakhin 7b:12:1.hebrew: פשיטא - דמש"ה אין נותנין, שהמת אסור בהנאה? אלא ודאי ה"ק: שנויי המת, כגון פיאה נכרית, אסורין בהנאה. ולהכי קתני להאי "מפני", משום דקא בעי לגלויי עלה, דלאו בשערה ממש קא מיירי:
Rashi on Arakhin 7b:12:1.english: [Isn't it] obvious - That for this reason one does not give [it], because a corpse is forbidden for benefit? Rather, certainly this is what [the baraita] is saying: The adornments of the deceased, such as a wig, are forbidden for benefit. And for this reason [the tanna] taught this [clause], "because," as he wanted to reveal regarding it that it is not dealing with her actual hair.

Rashi on Arakhin 7b:13:1.english: An animal that was executed is forbidden to derive benefit [from it] - Even its hair.

Rashi on Arakhin 7b:15:1.hebrew: אין נערכין פחות מסלע - שאפי' עני הנדור בהשג יד, לא יתן פחות מסלע:
Rashi on Arakhin 7b:15:1.english: One is not valuated at less than a sela - That even a poor person bound by a vow [assessed] according to [his] means shall not give less than a sela.

Rashi on Arakhin 7b:15:2.english: Nor more than fifty - For this is the greatest of the valuations written in the Torah portion.

Rashi on Arakhin 7b:15:3.hebrew: נתן סלע - בן עשרים שערכו חמישים, והיה עני ונתן סלע לערכו — דעני נידון בהשג יד — והעשיר, פטור:
Rashi on Arakhin 7b:15:3.english: [If] he gave a sela - [Such as] a twenty-year-old whose valuation is fifty [selas], and he was poor and gave a sela toward his valuation — for a poor person is judged according to [his] means — and [then] became wealthy, [he is] exempt.

Rashi on Arakhin 7b:15:4.hebrew: נותן חמשים - דבנתינה קמייתא לא יצא ידי ערכו, ועדיין ערכו עליו. ועני המעריך את עצמו והעשיר קודם נתינה — נותן ערך עשיר, כדילפינן לקמן בפ' השג יד (ערכין דף יז:):
Rashi on Arakhin 7b:15:4.english: [He] gives fifty - For with the first giving, he did not fulfill [his obligation for] his valuation, and his valuation is still upon him. And a poor person who valuates himself and becomes wealthy before giving [payment] gives the valuation of a wealthy person, as we derive below in the chapter [entitled] Hasheg Yad (Arakhin 17b).

Rashi on Arakhin 7b:16:1.hebrew: היו בידיו חמש סלעים - עני בן עשרים שהעריך עצמו, והיה לו ה' סלעים:
Rashi on Arakhin 7b:16:1.english: [If] there were five selas in his possession - A poor person twenty years of age who valuated himself, and had five selas.

Rashi on Arakhin 7b:1:1.hebrew: מחתך בבשר בעלמא הוא - ואין חיוב אלא בחובל בחי, דמוציא דם:
Rashi on Arakhin 7b:1:1.english: He is merely cutting flesh - And there is liability only for one who wounds a living [being], as he extracts blood.

Rashi on Arakhin 7b:20:1.hebrew: ההוא לכל ערכין שאתה מעריך הוא דאתא - שאפי' עני שבעניים לא יתן פחות, ומיהו היכא דאית ליה — טפי יהיב, דכתיב: "על פי אשר תשיג":
Rashi on Arakhin 7b:20:1.english: That [verse] comes [to teach regarding] all valuations that you valuate - That even the poorest of the poor shall not give less [than a sela]; however, where he has [more], he gives more, as it is written: "According to that which [the means of the one who vowed] can reach."

Rashi on Arakhin 7b:21:1.hebrew: יד הנודר ולא יד הנידר - שעני שהעריך את העשיר, נותן ערך עני:
Rashi on Arakhin 7b:21:1.english: The means of the one who vows and not the means of the one about whom the vow is made - That a poor person who valuated a wealthy person gives the valuation of a poor person.

Rashi on Arakhin 7b:21:2.hebrew: לאו ממילא שמעינן מינה כו' - אע"ג דקרא להכי אתא: "ולא יד הנידר", מיהו "על פי אשר תשיג" כתיב, וממילא שמעת דהיכא דידו משגת — שקול מיניה:
Rashi on Arakhin 7b:21:2.english: Do we not learn from it of itself, etc. - Even though the verse comes for this — [to teach:] "and not the means of the one valuated" — nevertheless, "according to that which [his means] can reach" is written, and it follows automatically that wherever his means suffice, take [payment] from him.

Rashi on Arakhin 7b:22:1.hebrew: ונתן ד' לשניה - על פי כהן, יצא ידי שניהן, ואפי' לרבנן, הואיל ויהב לשניה ברישא:
Rashi on Arakhin 7b:22:1.english: And he gave four [sela] to the second - [Having given] according to [the assessment of] a priest, he has fulfilled [his obligation for] both of them; and [this applies] even according to the Rabbis, since he gave to the second [vow] first.

Rashi on Arakhin 7b:23:1.hebrew: מה שגבה גבה - והילכך, כי יהיב לראשונה, כל מה דאית ליה יהיב לה; ולשניה, ליכא למימר: "אמאי לא יהב כולהו חמש?", משום דבעידנא דיהב לשניה משתעבד לה לראשונה, דהא אפילו מאי דיהיב לה — לאו דידה הוא:
Rashi on Arakhin 7b:23:1.english: Whatever he collected, he has collected - And therefore, when he gives to the first [vow], he gives all that he has to it; and regarding the second [vow], it cannot be said: "Why did he not give all five [selas]?", because at the time that he gave to the second, [his property] was liened to the first, for even that which he gave to it is not [rightfully] its own.

Rashi on Arakhin 7b:5:1.hebrew: (נהנין בשערה - רגילות היו נשים, כששערן מועט, לקשור שיער נשים נכריות לשערן, והוא פיאה נכרית):
Rashi on Arakhin 7b:5:1.english: ([One may] derive benefit from her hair - Women were accustomed, when their hair was sparse, to tie the hair of other women to their hair, and this is a wig.)

Rashi on Arakhin 7b:5:3.hebrew: בפיאה נכרית - לאו שערה ממש קאמר, אלא שהיתה לה פיאה משיער אשה אחרת קשורה לשערה [דרגילות היו נשים, כששערן מועט, לקשור שיער נשים נכריות לשערן, והוא פיאה נכרית], ואמרה: "תנו אותה לבתי". וקמ"ל מתני', דאע"ג דקשורה לה, כיון דאמרה "תנו" — גליא דעתה דלא ניחא לה דתיהוי כגופה לאיתסורי בהדיה, וכנטולה מחיים דמיא:
Rashi on Arakhin 7b:5:3.english: In [the case of] a wig - [He] did not mean her actual hair, but rather that she had a wig of another woman's hair tied to her hair [for women were accustomed, when their hair was sparse, to tie the hair of foreign women to their hair, and this is a wig], and she said, "Give it to my daughter." And the Mishnah teaches us that even though it was tied to her, since she said, "Give [it]," she revealed her intention that it is not agreeable to her that it should be like her body to become forbidden along with it, and it is considered like [hair] removed during [her] lifetime.

Rashi on Arakhin 7b:6:1.hebrew: שער נשים צדקניות - של עיר הנדחת, שלא הודחו עמה, מהו? ואמר רבא התם בחלק (סנהדרין קיב.): פיאה נכרית שקשרה הצדקת לשערה קא מיבעיא ליה — אי כגופה היא וניצול, אי כממונה. וקי"ל (שם): צדיקים שבתוכה יוצאין ממנה ערומים, וכל ממונם נשרף, דכתיב: "ואת כל שללה תקבוץ" וגו'. אלמא מספקא ליה: אי כגופה, אי לאו כגופה. ותיפשוט ליה מהכא דגופה הוא, דטעמא דאמרה "תנו" כו':
Rashi on Arakhin 7b:6:1.english: The hair of righteous women - [The hair of righteous women] of an apostate city who were not led astray with it, what is [its status]? And Rava said there in [the chapter of] Chelek (Sanhedrin 112a): He is inquiring about a wig that the righteous woman tied to her hair — is it [treated] like her body and saved, or is it like her property? And we maintain (ibid.): The righteous [people] within it leave it naked, and all their property is burned, as it is written: "And you shall gather all its spoil..." Evidently, it was uncertain to him whether it is [treated] like her body or whether it is not like her body. And let him resolve it from here, that it is [treated like] her body, for the reason [benefit is permitted] is that she said, "Give [it]," etc.

Rashi on Arakhin 7b:9:1.hebrew: קשיא ליה לר"נ - הא דמוקמינן למתניתין בפיאה נכרית — והא דומיא דבהמה קתני וכו':
Rashi on Arakhin 7b:9:1.english: [This] was difficult for Rav Naḥman - That which we established the Mishnah [as referring to] a wig — but surely [the Mishnah] teaches [it] similar to an animal, etc.?

Tosafot on Arakhin 7b:16:1.hebrew: אין נערכין פחות מסלע וכו' - "פחות מסלע והעשיר" — לאו דווקא "פחות מסלע", אלא אפי' נתן כל הערך חוץ מסלע אחד, מגלגלין עליו את הכל:
Tosafot on Arakhin 7b:16:1.english: "One cannot be valuated at less than a sela, etc." - [The statement,] "less than a sela and he became wealthy," is not specifically [only when he gave] less than a sela; rather, even if he gave the entire valuation except for one sela, we levy the entire [valuation] upon him.

Tosafot on Arakhin 7b:21:1.hebrew: ההוא יד הנודר ולא יד הנידר - ואם תאמר: מה לי לרבויי נידר, דאיצטריך קרא למעוטי? וי"ל: כיון דכתיב קרא (חמשים) (ויקרא כ״ז:כ״ה) "וכל ערכך יהיה בשקל הקדש", דלא יהא ערך פחות משקל, ואשכחן ערך חמשים — ס"ד דהאי טעמא משום השג יד, ידעינן מסברא ואזלינן בתר הנידר; קמ"ל קרא ד"אשר תשיג יד הנודר", דלא אזלינן בתר הנידר:
Tosafot on Arakhin 7b:21:1.english: "That [verse comes to teach] the means of the vower and not the means of the evaluated person" - And if you will say: Why would I include the evaluated person [to determine the valuation by his means], such that a verse was needed to exclude [him]? And one can say: Since the verse writes (fifty) [and] (Leviticus 27:25): "And all your valuation shall be according to the shekel of the Sanctuary," [teaching] that no valuation shall be less than a shekel, and we find a valuation of fifty — it would enter your mind [to say] that this reason is due to [financial] means, [which] we know from logical reasoning, and [consequently] we would follow the evaluated person; [therefore,] the verse teaches us: "[According to] the means of the vower," that we do not follow the evaluated person.

Tosafot on Arakhin 7b:24:1.hebrew: בעידנא דיהיב לראשון לית ליה - תימה: דבעידנא דנדר לראשון היה לו ה' סלעים, ואיך מפטר כשנתן להם אחת? התנן פרק השג יד (לקמן ערכין דף יז:): "היה עשיר" — פי' בשעת הנדר — "והעני" — כשבא לפרוע לכהן; או "עני" — כשנדר ולא נתן כלום — "והעשיר" — "נותן ערך עשיר"! ואומר רבינו, דהך דלקמן דוקא שהעריכו הכהן בעודו עשיר, ולכך כשהעני שוב — נותן ערך עשיר; אבל אם נדר כשהוא עשיר ולא הוערך, והעני — נותן ערך עני. ובשמעתין הכי הוא: נתן ד' לשניה — שהכהן העריכו תחילה על השניה, וחזר והעריכו על הראשון, ונתן על פיו אחד על הראשון; ולכך נפטר ממנה, דלא הוערך עליה בעוד שהיו בידו החמש סלעים:
Tosafot on Arakhin 7b:24:1.english: "At the time he gave [payment] for the first, he has no [more]" - [This is] difficult: For at the time he vowed for the first [valuation], he had five sela, and how is he exempt [from paying in full] when he gave them [only] one [sela]? For didn't we learn in the Mishnah in chapter Hasheg Yad (below, Arakhin 17b): "[If] he was wealthy" — meaning at the time of the vow — "and became poor" — when he came to pay the priest; or "[if he was] poor" — when he vowed and gave nothing — "and became wealthy" — "[he] gives the valuation of a wealthy person"! And Rabbeinu says that this [Mishnah] below [applies] specifically where the priest evaluated him while he was [still] wealthy, and therefore when he subsequently became poor, he gives the valuation of a wealthy person; but if he vowed when he was wealthy and was not evaluated, and [then] became poor, he gives the valuation of a poor person. And in our sugya it is so: He gave four [sela] for the second [vow], for the priest evaluated him first for the second [vow], and [then] evaluated him for the first [vow], and he gave one [sela] for the first [vow] according to his [the priest's] assessment; and therefore he was discharged from it, for he was not evaluated for it while the five sela were [still] in his possession.
